## Bounded Meadow fixtures · 30 September 2026

These deterministic acceptance inputs are separate from the restored browser session. The [bounded proof](../../docs/Observatory-Meadow-Bounded-Proof-01.md), [F2 reviewed report](../../docs/evidence/meadow-proof-01/f-canopy-continuation-v2-2026-09-30T20-41-39-185Z/f-reviewed-report.md) and [project documentation index](../../docs/README.md) explain their scope.

| Fixture | Recorded meaning |
|---|---|
| `meadow-benchmark-v1.json` | Immutable A benchmark: original lens, seed, numerical criteria and historical poses, including its original downward vector. |
| `meadow-placement-c1.json` | Fixed C placement/support and identity expectations. |
| `meadow-art-e2.json` | Immutable E2 botanical appearance contract, appearance revision 2. |
| `meadow-e-visual-exit-v2.json` | Immutable E visual-exit revision 2; corrects only the historical downward orientation as documented in the bounded proof. |

| `meadow-f-motion-v1.json` | Immutable original F walking, rotation and elevation sequence. |
| `meadow-canopy-f2.json` | Separately versioned F2 successor, fixture revision 2, appearance 4 / canopy 2 / material 3. |
| `meadow-f-motion-v2.json` | Separately versioned motion revision 2 retaining the original sequence vectors, cadence and conditions for F2. |

The F2 successors preserve the original acceptance camera vectors, lens, seed, resolution, ROI, depth thresholds, density and coverage criteria. Historical F1 expectations remain separately testable; a new revision does not replace an earlier fixture or evidence record.

Two depth/ID protocols remain explicit. Preserved E protocol revision 1 samples half-sized depth UV coordinates while object IDs use full-canvas pixels. F measurement revision 2 fetches depth at that same object-ID pixel. The unchanged ROI is `[0.18, 0.42, 0.82, 0.94]`, pixel-centre bounds are `[346, 454, 1574, 1015]`, eligible terrain depth is 2–15 m and the minimum coverage is 70%. The density criterion remains 200–300 blades/m². Report both protocols without relabelling historical results.

With the ordinary local app served, run the focused F suite and separate browser worker parity sequentially:

```sh
node tests/meadow-canopy-fixtures.cjs
npm run test:ib075:f
node tests/meadow-canopy-worker-browser.cjs
```

The F npm script does not include the separate worker-parity browser command. Ordinary-app capture settings use `IB075_F_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8766/`, `IB075_F_HEADLESS=0` and a fresh `IB075_F_OUTPUT` directory. Inspect runners before execution, preserve any outputs they can rewrite, and restore historical reports byte-for-byte after retaining regenerated results separately.

H measurement implementation is PASS; fixed-resolution performance/resource certification is FAIL, retained CPU-memory attribution is INCOMPLETE and H remains IN PROGRESS.
